correctness.rationale: The connected weighted complete graph has K=N tr[(L+J/N)^(-1)]-N and is strictly convex in independent weights; symmetry and uniqueness force two conductance orbits a,b. The Laplacian nonzero spectrum is 2a+(N-2)b with multiplicity N/2 and Nb with multiplicity N/2-1. Budget m(ta+(N-2)b)=1 converts K to C+A y+B/y, y=2(a/b)+N-2. This proves threshold t=N^2/(N^2-2N+2), deleted matching at/above threshold, interior solution and exact critical window; independently inverted full Laplacians for N=4,6,8,12 and compared values. At t>=2 B<=0 yields monotone objective; boundary properly treated.
